decisions: Minutes from the January 18, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Additional $350,000 allocated to technology infrastructure budget for 2025; formal budget review checkpoint scheduled for May 2025.
Dedicated project liaison assigned to Polestar Industries for Phase 2 of the engagement; executive check-in call with Polestar Industries COO to be scheduled by February 28, 2025.
Recruitment authorized for two senior consultants and one operations coordinator, with a target start date of April 1, 2025.
Nexlify selected as cloud-based technology platform vendor; contract negotiations to be finalized by March 7, 2025; implementation to commence Q2 2025.
Aiyana Park to lead a 10th anniversary client appreciation event planning committee; proposal to be presented at the March 22, 2025 board meeting.
